props.name: header
props.description: The header region — usually a Navbar.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: The left rail or sidebar. Hidden below the lg breakpoint.

props.name: children
props.description: The page content, rendered inside the main landmark.

props.name: framed
props.description: Reproduce the floating rounded window from xl up. Turn it off for a conventional full-bleed application.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum content width. The design targets 1512px.

props.name: embedded
props.description: Render inside a host page rather than as the page — a docs preview, a marketing embed, a Storybook canvas. The content region becomes a plain region instead of a second `main` landmark, and the skip link is left to the host, which already has one. Layout is unchanged.
